name: Investor visas

investment_route.text_en: Which investment activity or corporate role will you undertake in Indonesia?

own_shareholding.text_en: Do you personally own shares worth at least IDR 10 billion (or equivalent) in the sponsoring company registered with the Ministry of Investment/BKPM?

sponsor.text_en: Will that company sponsor your visa application?

investment_commitment_e28b_5y.text_en: For the 5-year stay: Can you commit to establishing an Indonesian company with placed shares or investment of at least USD 2.5 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28b_10y.text_en: For the 10-year stay: Can you commit to establishing an Indonesian company with placed shares or investment of at least USD 5 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28d_5y.text_en: For the 5-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 25 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28d_10y.text_en: For the 10-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 50 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28f_5y.text_en: For the 5-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 5 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28f_10y.text_en: For the 10-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 10 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28g_5y.text_en: For the 5-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 25 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28g_10y.text_en: For the 10-year stay: Will the foreign company commit to invest at least USD 50 million, fulfilled within 90 days after entry?

investment_commitment_e28c_5y.text_en: For the 5-year stay: do you hold Indonesian government bonds, listed-company shares or mutual funds worth at least USD 350,000?

investment_commitment_e28c_10y.text_en: For the 10-year stay: do you hold Indonesian government bonds, listed-company shares or mutual funds worth at least USD 700,000, or an apartment worth at least USD 1,000,000?

stay_months.text_en: How many months do you need to stay in Indonesia?

notes: E28 and E28E are secondary NOT_FOUND cards, excluded from the Guide; unknown fields remain null + TO_VERIFY.
E28A is the Investor KITAS. Only its three exact commercial keys exist in the price list. No 1-year or Golden Visa price is invented; is_sold for unpriced codes remains null.
Investor KITAP + MERP exists in the price list but is not mapped to a code: ITAP.json has no verified per-code conversion. DB itap stays null for all codes.

Initial stays retain YEAR units; comparison uses exactly 12 MONTHS per YEAR. max_total_months uses exact calendar equivalents of the supplementary official table: 6 YEAR = 72 MONTH, 10 YEAR = 120 MONTH. No years are converted to days.
E28A page offers 1 or 2 years; the supplementary table says 2 years for the first ITAS. Preserve both; TO_VERIFY. The Guide follows the code page for initial choices.
E28G has substantive official text and is reachable, but current classification remains TO_VERIFY; no retirement or successor code is inferred. Its cumulative maximum is unknown.
Activity routes overlap: E28A also allows company establishment and corporate roles. The Guide follows the selected route and does not assert exclusivity or full eligibility.

Golden Visa investment commitments are asked for the stay tier actually selected (guide.py requires_question_by_stay): stay months first, the smallest fitting 5/10-year option, then one yes/no on that tier's exact card amount (investment_commitment_<code>_5y / _10y). A no gives NOT_COVERED naming the tier; there is no silent downgrade to the lower tier. E28C apartment alternative exists only in the 10-year requirements and conflicts with the securities-only summary; no standalone property route is inferred. A yes answer does not verify the commitment. Documents remain a result checklist.
Offshore/onshore application location and code-specific ITAP conversion remain null + TO_VERIFY. Commercial price-key names do not establish legal application-channel rules.
